# Admizz Education

Dreaming of studying abroad? Admizz Education helps you explore top destinations, apply to global universities, and prepare for success- all through one global portal.

Admizz Education is a study-abroad consultancy based in Nepal, founded in 2015 by Manish K Sah (Founder & CEO, Admizz Group), with offices in Kathmandu (Opposite to Nabil Bank, Sita Ram Square, 4th Floor, Putalisadak, Kathmandu 44600) and Bengaluru (Kanakapura Main Road). Its Kathmandu office is rated 4.9 from 122 Google reviews (as of October 2026). It guides students through university selection, admissions, scholarships, student visas and test preparation. Contact: hello@admizz.com, +977-9802728444.

## Services
- [Education Consultancy in Nepal](https://admizzeducation.com/top-education-consultancy-in-nepal): End-to-end guidance for studying abroad.
- [Visa Assistance for Study Abroad](https://admizzeducation.com/visa-assistance-for-study-abroad): Student visa assistance for the USA, UK, Canada, Australia and more — documents, mock interviews, application review.
- [Scholarship Assistance in Nepal](https://admizzeducation.com/scholarship-assistance-in-nepal): Finding and applying for merit-based and need-based scholarships.
- [Career Counseling for International Students](https://admizzeducation.com/career-counseling-for-international-students): Choosing the right country, course and university.
- [Test Preparation Services in Nepal](https://admizzeducation.com/test-prep): IELTS, TOEFL, GRE, PTE, SAT and Duolingo coaching.
- [University & College Partnerships](https://admizzeducation.com/universities): Partner universities and colleges.
- [Recruitment Partners](https://admizzeducation.com/recruitment-partners)

- [Can You Take Dependants on a UK Student Visa? (2027)](https://admizzeducation.com/uk-student-visa-dependants-rules-2027): Only some students can bring family to the UK. Here is who qualifies in 2027, what each dependant costs and what your options are if you cannot bring them.
- [UK Scholarships for Nepalese Students (2027 Guide)](https://admizzeducation.com/uk-scholarships-for-Nepalese-students-2027): Funding can change whether a UK degree is affordable. This guide covers Chevening, GREAT, university awards and elite awards, with eligibility, timing and tips.
- [How Much Bank Balance Is Needed for a UK Student Visa?](https://admizzeducation.com/bank-balance-required-uk-student-visa-2027): You must show tuition plus living funds for 28 days. Here are the exact UK student visa amounts for 2027 with worked examples, including a rise on 30 November 2026.
- [UK Intakes and Application Timeline for 2027](https://admizzeducation.com/uk-intake-timeline-Nepalese-students-2027): UK intakes for Nepalese students in 2027: January, May and September, with a month-by-month application, CAS, funds and visa timeline.
- [UK Student Visa 28-Day Rule for Nepalese Students (2027)](https://admizzeducation.com/uk-student-visa-28-day-rule-Nepalese-students-2027): Your UK student visa funds must sit in the bank for 28 straight days. Here is exactly how the rule works for Nepalese students, with amounts and common mistakes.
- [UK January 2027 Intake — Deadlines and Courses](https://admizzeducation.com/uk-january-2027-intake-Nepalese-students): Still planning a January 2027 start in the UK? Nepalese students: deadlines, courses, universities and the timeline to apply before funds rise on 30 Nov.
- [UK Student Visa Cost 2027: Fee, IHS & Funds for Nepal](https://admizzeducation.com/uk-student-visa-cost-2027): UK student visa cost for Nepali students: £558 fee, £776 a year health surcharge and funds of £1,203 or £1,570 a month from 30 Nov 2026.
- [Germany Blocked Account 2026: How Much Nepali Students Need (€11,904)](https://admizzeducation.com/germany-blocked-account-2026-nepali-students): Germany requires €11,904 a year (€992 a month) as proof of funds in 2026. How the blocked account works and the alternatives for Nepali students.
- [H-1B Wage-Weighted Lottery 2026: What Nepali F-1 and OPT Students Must Know](https://admizzeducation.com/h1b-wage-weighted-lottery-2026-nepali-students-opt): The H-1B lottery now gives higher-paid jobs more entries. How the wage-level rule works and what Nepali students on F-1 and OPT should do.
- [Study Abroad Rule Changes Calendar 2026-2028: UK, USA, Canada](https://admizzeducation.com/study-abroad-rule-changes-calendar-2026-2028): The dates that matter for Nepali students: UK Graduate Route 18 months, US fixed admission period, Canada's 2026 cap and the UK levy from 2028.
- [How to Choose a Genuine Education Consultancy in Nepal (2026 Checklist)](https://admizzeducation.com/how-to-choose-genuine-education-consultancy-nepal-2026): Rules for education agents are tightening in the UK and Australia. A practical checklist to tell a trustworthy study abroad consultancy from a risky one.
- [UK International Student Levy From 2028: What It Means for Nepali Students](https://admizzeducation.com/uk-international-student-levy-2028-nepali-students): England will charge universities £925 per international student per year from 1 August 2028. What the levy is, who pays, and how Nepali applicants should plan.
- [Canada Study Permit Cap 2026: What Nepali Students Must Know](https://admizzeducation.com/canada-study-permit-cap-2026-nepali-students): Canada will accept 309,670 study permit applications under its 2026 cap. See who needs a PAL, who is exempt, and how Nepali students should plan.
- [Canada PAL Requirement for Nepali Students 2026](https://admizzeducation.com/answers/canada-pal-requirement-nepali-students): Most new bachelor's and college applicants need a PAL for Canada in 2026. Master's and PhD students at public institutions are exempt.
- [Germany Blocked Account Amount 2026: Short Answer](https://admizzeducation.com/answers/germany-blocked-account-amount-2026): The 2026 German blocked account amount is €11,904 a year, which is €992 a month, released monthly after you arrive.
- [UK Student Visa Bank Balance from Nepal: Short Answer](https://admizzeducation.com/answers/uk-student-visa-bank-balance-nepal): UK student visa funds: £1,203 a month outside London or £1,570 in London from 30 Nov 2026 (£1,171 and £1,529 before), plus tuition.
- [UK Student Visa English Requirement: Short Answer](https://admizzeducation.com/answers/uk-student-visa-english-requirement): For a degree-level course you need CEFR level B2. Below degree level you need B1. Use an approved test or your university's own assessment.
- [UK Student Visa Fee and Health Surcharge: Short Answer](https://admizzeducation.com/answers/uk-student-visa-fee-nepal): The UK Student visa costs £558 from outside the UK, plus £776 a year for the health surcharge: £1,164 for a visa of 18 months or less.
- [UK Student Visa Processing Time from Nepal](https://admizzeducation.com/answers/uk-student-visa-processing-time-nepal): GOV.UK says you will usually get a UK Student visa decision within 3 weeks if you apply from outside the UK. You can apply 6 months early.
- [UK Student Visa TB Test from Nepal: Short Answer](https://admizzeducation.com/answers/uk-tb-test-nepal): Nepal is on the UK TB test list. If you are coming for 6 months or more you need a test at an approved clinic, valid 6 months from the x-ray.
- [Admizz Education: Accreditation, Experience & Results](https://admizzeducation.com/accreditation-and-results): Facts about Admizz Education: an ICEF-accredited agency helping students apply abroad since 2016, with 8,000+ students enrolled and 100+ partner institutions.
- [Study Abroad Rule Changes: Latest Updates for Nepal](https://admizzeducation.com/study-abroad-rule-updates): A dated list of study abroad rule changes for Nepali students: UK, USA, Canada and Australia, with what changed and links to official sources.
- [COMPEX Scholarship 2026: Exam Date, Form & Syllabus Guide](https://admizzeducation.com/compex-scholarship-2026-complete-guide-for-nepalese-students-to-study-in-india): COMPEX 2026 for Nepali students: expected exam timeline, application form process, exam pattern and eligibility, with guidance from Admizz Education.
